identity.name: Black Bay GMT
identity.one_liner: Tudor's first in-house GMT, launched in 2018 with a red-and-blue bezel that nods to the Rolex GMT-Master 'Pepsi' made by Tudor's sibling brand.

narrative.story: Introduced at Baselworld 2018 alongside the Black Bay Fifty-Eight, the Black Bay GMT was Tudor's first true GMT complication, built around the in-house MT5652 caliber with an independently adjustable local hour hand. The bi-color bezel is a direct homage to the Rolex GMT-Master, which Tudor's parent company also makes, and earned the watch its 'Pepsi' nickname within weeks of launch.
narrative.collector_notes: Bracelet, dial print, and lume color have gone through small updates since 2018, so buyers comparing early examples check the caseback and any box/papers date rather than assume every 79830RB is identical.
